history.summary: A large 1130 sqft 2BR in Ang Mo Kio (D20) at just $1,416 psf — ~9% under the $1,557 URA median — near Ang Mo Kio MRT (780m, future CRL interchange). Big, low-psf, established-estate value play with 6.5% resale CAGR. Tempered by 21-year age and reported below-par estate maintenance, but a solid Buy.
history.rating_rationale: $1,416 psf is the lowest in the batch and ~9% below the $1,557 median for a spacious 1130 sqft layout — a strong value/$-per-sqft proposition for D20's deep owner-occupier estate. Ang Mo Kio is a mature town with Cross Island Line interchange (CR11) coming, 780m walk. 6.5% resale CAGR on 88 txns is solid. 579 units gives reasonable liquidity. Drags: built 2005 (21 yrs old, ~74 yrs lease left) and resident reviews flag mediocre maintenance and heavy-handed management — manageable but real for a hold/resale.
red_flags: 21 years old (built 2005); lease decay and higher maintenance ahead
Resident reviews cite below-par estate maintenance and restrictive management
catalysts: Ang Mo Kio becomes a Cross Island Line interchange (CR11) — connectivity uplift
Large 1130 sqft layout at low $1,416 psf appeals to right-sizing families and own-stay buyers
Established AMK estate with deep, stable owner-occupier demand

history.summary: Large, established 99LH near AMK Town Centre with a genuinely big 1,582 sqft 3BR priced at PSF 1422 — a 9% discount to the project median PSF of 1557. Strong 6.5%/yr URA resale appreciation on 88 transactions, a 579-unit liquid base, and the future CR11 Ang Mo Kio Cross Island Line interchange make this a solid value play.
history.rating_rationale: PSF 1422 vs URA median 1557 is a meaningful ~9% discount on a unit that is large and well-located (5-9 min to AMK hub, mall, bus interchange). 6.5%/yr resale-only appreciation on a healthy 88-txn sample is well above the OCR baseline. 579 units gives deep liquidity, and the Cross Island Line interchange at AMK (CR11, ~2030) is a real catalyst. At $2.25M the unit sits at the upper edge of the deep buyer band but the large floor area justifies it. Build is 2005-era but reviews report decent upkeep; aging facilities and 21-year age are the main drags.
red_flags: 2005 build (21 years old) — higher maintenance, finishes dated; some reviews note aging facilities
Large 1,582 sqft pushes quantum to $2.25M, narrowing the buyer pool vs sub-$2M peers
780m to MRT is a moderate (not doorstep) walk
catalysts: CR11 Ang Mo Kio Cross Island Line interchange (~2030) adds a second line to the existing NSL
PSF ~9% below project median leaves room for re-rating toward the median
AMK Town Centre amenities, schools and en-bloc-scale 579-unit liquidity
